verdict.rationale: mise ships a first-party MCP server via the `mise mcp` subcommand, documented on its own docs page. It lets an AI assistant read a project's tools, tasks, environment variables and config files, and run its tasks. missing for 10: documented client-connection setup steps (e.g., agent config examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: `mise mcp` runs a Model Context Protocol server that lets an AI assistant read a project's tools, tasks, environment variables and config files, and run its tasks.
The mise MCP server lets an AI assistant inspect a project's tools, tasks, environment, and configuration, and run mise tasks.
